topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 51 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 10 ERC20 tokens, 12 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 5 functional families. Its contracts share 12 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, erc1967upgrade, erc165). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
